parameters.name: Records
parameters.description: The resolution records. This parameter is valid only when Type is set to A.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The internal domain name resolution type. Valid values:

*   VPC: resolution for VPC access authorizations. A resolution of this type can be bound only to traditional dedicated instances.
*   A: resolution that supports A records. A resolution of this type can be bound only to VPC integration dedicated instances.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi create-private-dns --intranet-domain api.demo.com --type A --records Record=192.168.0.1 Weight=100 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
